name: gitring
description: Connects Claude Code to your gitring: the tools, a skill for the work loop, and a hook that brings change requests after each file edit.

gitring_url.title: gitring address
gitring_url.description: The address of your gitring, for example https://<your-worker>.workers.dev. Do not add /mcp or a slash at the end.

project.title: Project id (for the hook)
project.description: The gitring project that this computer works on. The hook needs it. The environment variable GITRING_PROJECT takes precedence.

api_key.title: Personal API key (for the hook)
api_key.description: A gitring API key (gk_...) with the member role. The hook needs it. The environment variable GITRING_KEY takes precedence.
